hints.title: Circular Array Virtual Expansion
hints.text: Append the first k - 1 elements to the end of colors to represent circular contiguous segments.

hints.title: Run-length Alternation
hints.text: Maintain a running counter of consecutive alternating elements. Increment if colors[i] does not equal colors[i - 1], else reset to 1.

hints.title: Window Threshold
hints.text: Whenever the alternating run length reaches at least k, increment the valid group count.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking alternating streak length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all n windows of size k independently takes O(n * k) causing TLE for n, k = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(k) auxiliary memory to slice circular wrap prefix.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use two-pointer alternating run length over virtual circular array expansion.
